keys.custody: offline, on the owner machine. Never in this repository and never a CI secret (owner decision, PND-034 option A).

policy.note: The public keys that may sign api/attestation.json. This file is published by the web host, which means a compromised host can serve a key of its own choosing: compare the fingerprint of the active key against this repository (git) and against the fingerprint recorded in the release documentation before trusting a signature. A signature is only evidence of provenance when the key is witnessed somewhere the signer does not control.
